detail.title: Bind tautology factories to Episteme's versioned factory contract
detail.description:
Purpose: turn the new Python tautology/Cook-cycle factory architecture into a real Episteme integration without inventing a cross-language contract.

Starting point:

* Python side now follows the Episteme pattern: fluent factory -> detached immutable build description -> separate evaluator -> typed result/trace -> explicit limits and failures.
* Tautology work classifies binary TRUE generation and keeps it distinct from recognition and functional completeness.
* Direct runtime interoperability is NOT yet established.

Required:

1. Resolve the authoritative Episteme source revision and exact admitted factory-description schema.
2. Define versioned Episteme families/operators for Boolean basis analysis and the bounded state-cycle verifier.
3. Preserve caller origin, operation IDs/versions, limits, traces, derivations, incomplete/failure semantics, and GENERATE != VERIFY != ADMIT.
4. Build cross-language replay fixtures: the same frozen plan must produce the same typed result in Python and Episteme for all admitted cases.
5. Include positive, negative, boundary, mutation, zero-budget and exhausted-budget checks.
6. Preserve ordered Boolean states 00/01/10/11; XOR is allowed only as a derived difference relation and may not collapse 01 with 10 where orientation matters.
7. Do not transfer mathematical evidence merely because the two implementations agree.

Claim ceilings:
ARCHITECTURE_TRANSFER != RUNTIME_INTEGRATION
CROSS_LANGUAGE_REPLAY != MATHEMATICAL_PROOF
GENERATES_TRUE != FUNCTIONAL_COMPLETENESS
FINITE_BOOLEAN_CLASSIFICATION != P_VS_NP_RESULT

Related research issue: <issue id="4705ea0e-e60f-41c3-b1e5-dd232a1e8705" href="https://linear.app/fighting-decay-of-knowlege/issue/FIG-22/classify-tautology-generating-boolean-primitives">FIG-22</issue>.

comments.body:
Architecture checkpoint preserved in GitHub PR #4: https://github.com/redogit/knowledge-decay/pull/4

The Python implementation now follows the verified Episteme factory shape:
fluent factory -> detached immutable build plan -> separate evaluator -> typed result/trace -> explicit limits/failure.

Direct Episteme runtime integration is deliberately still OPEN. The next admission gate is to recover the authoritative Episteme serialized factory schema and prove cross-language replay for frozen plans. Agreement must not promote mathematical evidence.

ARCHITECTURE_TRANSFER != RUNTIME_INTEGRATION
CROSS_LANGUAGE_REPLAY != MATHEMATICAL_PROOF
